reason: I only say yes because I pay nothing unless my boys actually use it, and the founder comes and sets it up himself in the quiet months, not in May when I have no time to breathe. If the AMC reminders go out on their own, that alone protects money I lose every year from missed renewals.
objection: I paid for a job app before and within a few weeks my technicians went back to calling me and sending WhatsApp. The first month they may use it because it is new, but by the third month, in the summer rush, will they still press that button after every job?
